answer: Inter-arrival delta mirror gate: each agent's request timing is compared against a sparrow-shaped baseline—sparse, jittered bursts—via a rolling mirror of its own prior inter-arrival deltas. New agents must first pass a calibration window where traffic shape must match natural burstiness within tolerance. Sybil clusters flood in lockstep, producing low-variance deltas that fail the mirror check and get throttled to a trickle.
